Title: Azure Private Link Service is now generally available in China

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link for customer owned services are now available in China Regions. 

With the general availability of private endpoint and Private Link service resources, Azure customers and partners can create a Private Link service on Azure and render it privately to their consumer's virtual networks using private endpoints.

Get started with Azure Private Link documentation.
